identity.label: diagnostic-candidate

correctness: Every receipt must be unique, non-duplicate, positive-sequence, and identify the expected receiver
Every delivered envelope must match its receipt ID/sequence, sender, receiver, kind, MIME and all 128 payload bytes
Every batch cursor and acknowledgment must advance through contiguous delivered sequences
Every receipt including warmup must match exactly one persisted inbox record; reject extra records, sequence gaps, and broken SHA-256 chain links
All receivers are empty and their acknowledged cursors equal the verified heads before shutdown
Running /proc/PID/exe hash must match the selected executable; source/helper/binary hashes must remain stable throughout the run
plan.distributed_inboxes: C enrolled sender sessions self-send; one additional read/ack connection per same agent identity, so C=100 is 100 enrolled agents
limitations: One host and filesystem; one 10-second sample per condition does not establish confidence intervals
The Python GIL, client parsing and thread scheduling, plus concurrent receiver maintenance, are included
A single sender with one outstanding request provides no overlap for group commit
Fixed 128-byte payload and closed-loop request arrival; this does not establish a maximum externally paced arrival rate
Readback of persisted records checks contents and integrity; crash-durability claims require separate failure-injection evidence
Fresh daemon and bus root per condition; warmup is excluded and enrollment is outside timing
plan.quantiles: Nearest rank p50/p95/p99 of client call latency in milliseconds, excluding warmups
plan.rate_denominator: Wall time from sender barrier release through the last receipt for a send admitted before the measurement deadline
plan.rate_numerator: Every successful durable send acknowledgment for requests admitted during that window, including completions after its deadline

receiver_drain.accounting: Concurrent drain, verification, and ack overhead remain inside the measured send workload; final catch-up is outside its window
receiver_drain.capacity: All warmups are delivered and acked before measurement; drain continuously during measurement to avoid the unchanged 10000-message inbox cap
receiver_drain.connections: One independent receiver connection and drain thread per destination inbox
receiver_drain.operation: Every interval, repeatedly wait_message(timeout_s=0) and ack each returned default-size batch until empty

plan.same_inbox: C enrolled sender sessions send to one additional receiver session
plan.scheduling: Closed loop: each sender waits for its durable receipt before issuing its next send; a barrier starts each window

targets_declared_before_measurement.100_active_senders: Apply and report the absolute 10 ms p50 comparison at C=100 with this workload explicitly named; no numeric definition of without degradation is inferred
targets_declared_before_measurement.application: Report 5000/s independently for every topology and concurrency; no aggregate or best-case substitution
targets_declared_before_measurement.unloaded_idle_controls: Run unchanged benchmark_transport.py with defaults against each executable and retain its serial append, unloaded UDS/HTTP, one-active/100-idle, and 100-active cycle controls

plan.transport: persistent AF_UNIX NDJSON JSON-RPC via benchmark_transport.Uds
